correctness.rationale: For K(2,n) arc-vertices of D=K(2,n-1), the two outgoing arcs at each D vertex have equal incoming predecessor sets, so any identifying code contains at least one of the two, giving >=3*2^{n-2}. Equality forces exactly one selected outgoing and (by nonempty signatures) exactly one selected incoming at each lower-order vertex, a cycle cover. Signatures of omitted arcs are distinct singletons; signatures of selected arcs are pairs, with collisions exactly at selected digons. In D=L(H), independent two-way local switches at H vertices enumerate all cycle covers. Exactly three alternating digons forbid one local two-switch pattern each, disjoint for n>=4 (giving 3^3*2^{3*2^{n-3}-6}), while n=3 admits only <=1 backtracking switch and n=2 the two Hamiltonian triangles. Uniform independent local sampling follows from this bijection. Independent literal-code enumeration confirmed 2,4,27 optimum codes at n=2,3,4. Finite tests are not proof for all n.
